blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — The police force in Northern Mindanao on Tuesday assured the safety of Japanese expatriates and those looking to visit or invest in the region. The Police Regional Office-10 (PRO-10) rolled out the welcome mat for Ono Hirotaka, Japan’s Consul General in Davao, during a security briefing at Camp Alagar here.
